# Vino

> Vino (GitHub: vino3dx) is a CG Generalist and Technical Artist working on real-time graphics, game engine tooling, shaders, VFX, DCC automation and AI-assisted development workflows.

Vino works across 3D production and real-time development: building tools, plugins, shaders and interactive systems for game engines and DCC applications, and documenting the process on vinofx.com.

## Identity

- Name: Vino
- Alternate names: Vino Studio, vino3dx
- Role: CG Generalist & Technical Artist
- Website: https://vinofx.com/
- GitHub: https://github.com/vino3dx

## Areas of work

- Technical art and real-time graphics
- Game engine development with Godot and Unreal Engine
- Shader development (HLSL, GLSL) and rendering work
- DCC automation for 3ds Max, Blender and Houdini
- Developer tools, plugins and asset pipeline automation
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that let AI agents drive DCC and game engine software
- Interactive applications, visualization systems and projection-based installations

## Tools and languages

- Engines: Godot, Unreal Engine
- DCC: 3ds Max, Blender, Houdini
- Languages: C++, Python, GDScript
- Shading: HLSL, GLSL
- Additional stack used in published repositories: C#, TypeScript / Node.js, MAXScript

## Projects

- [3dsmax-mcp](https://github.com/vino3dx/3dsmax-mcp): MCP server that lets AI agents control and automate Autodesk 3ds Max for modelling, shading, rigging, animation, rendering, baking and engine export.
- [vino-godot-mcp](https://github.com/vino3dx/vino-godot-mcp): Standalone MCP server for Godot that reads and writes project files directly through a text AST parser, without launching the editor for daily work.
- [godot-vinokit](https://github.com/vino3dx/godot-vinokit): Godot utility library with reusable modules for asset management, config persistence, license verification, UI tooling and hardware communication.
- [godot-yolo-faceswap](https://github.com/vino3dx/godot-yolo-faceswap): Offline AI face swap and restoration component for Unity and Godot Mono, built on ONNX Runtime, YOLOv8 and GFPGAN.
- [labor-3dsmax](https://github.com/vino3dx/labor-3dsmax): Modular 3ds Max workflow toolkit focused on repetitive object organisation tasks and the 3ds Max to Unreal Engine pipeline.
- [labor-blender](https://github.com/vino3dx/labor-blender): Blender scene assembly toolkit ported from the 3ds Max AssemblyTool, covering placement and assembly tasks.
- [license-generator](https://github.com/vino3dx/license-generator): Offline license system for Godot 4 projects with AES-256 encrypted license files, project binding and expiry checks.
- [ue-prime-kit](https://github.com/vino3dx/ue-prime-kit): Unreal Engine 5.1 C++ base project and plugin kit for building Blueprint-exposed editor tools.
- [vision-arena](https://github.com/vino3dx/vision-arena): AR football game that uses YOLOv11 ball detection over a camera feed to control objects inside Godot.
- [godot_cpp_plugin_dev](https://github.com/vino3dx/godot_cpp_plugin_dev): Quickstart template for GDExtension development with Godot 4, including build and release workflows.

Full project index: https://github.com/vino3dx/vino3dx/blob/main/PROJECTS.md
